mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 3.0% signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates on equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 3.0%, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 5.0% signals tightening labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy and suppress equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE is below 5.0%, or the mean return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts above 2000 thousand units signals strong consumer demand and confidence, which drives corporate revenue expectations and supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST exceeds 2000, or the average return in such periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 119.0 index points signals weakening manufacturing activity and economic contraction, which triggers risk-off sentiment and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is below 119.0, or the average return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in both residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signals a synchronized housing market boom that reflects broad-based consumer confidence and rising disposable income, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in less than 50% of instances where both RSAFS and HOUST are rising, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05 in interaction regression).

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising inflation (CPIAUCSL) and unchanged or rising federal funds rate signals persistent inflationary pressures that prevent monetary easing, leading to elevated discount rates and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 194.0 and FEDFUNDS >= 3.2%, or the joint signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strong labor market recovery that increases wage pressures and inflation expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to anticipated rate hikes.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 100k and UNRATE decreases > 0.2pp in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where both PAYEMS rises >100k and UNRATE falls >0.2pp, or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained expansion in real GDP (GDPC1) combined with stable inflation (CPIAUCSL < 195.0) signals a healthy, non-inflationary growth environment that supports positive equity valuations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances where GDPC1 > 11000 and CPIAUCSL < 195.0, or the interaction effect has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
